messages:
Sarah: Heads up — drafting the relnotes for the next docs push (0.12.0). Need sign-off on feature blurbs and a short Known Issues section. Who can help with SDK snippet fixes and a linkcheck?
Tony: I can do SDK snippets. Which ones are broken/renamed?@Sarah
Sarah: Main items: JS client param rename (batch_size -> maxBatch), Python streaming sync->async examples, embedding call param rename (embedding_model -> model_for_embeddings). Also found a redirect loop for /guides/migrate-legacy.
Joni: I’ll run linkcheck now. Using `./scripts/linkcheck.sh --base /docs --report` — will paste findings. Saw a 301 loop on /guides/migrate-legacy and a couple of 404s for old snippet anchors.
Tony: For the JS snippet I propose swapping this:
```js
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'kestrel', prompt: 'hi', batch_size: 8 })
```
with this:
```js
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'kestrel', prompt: 'hi', maxBatch: 8 })
```
I’ll add a short migration note under "SDK breaking changes".
Sarah: Perfect. Also add an inline note in the snippet that client.generate now returns streamable chunks by default for large outputs.
Tony: Will do. I’ll open PR with snippet edits + callout.
Joni: Linkcheck results (summary): 12 warnings, 3 404s (old snippet anchors), 1 redirect loop (/guides/migrate-legacy). I added a TODO comment in PR #4521 and attached the raw output.
Kevin: Small request — update the embeddings example to use the new route name `vectorize` in examples, but keep a deprecation blurb: `/v1/embeddings` still works but will be deprecated. I’ll add server-side redirect with 2-week notice header.
Sarah: Also include in Known Issues: "Streaming on quantized models may drop trailing punctuation for sequences > 1024 tokens". Product suggested mitigations (reduce chunk_size or use larger non-quantized variant). Add this as a short callout and link to the eval that surfaced it.
Joni: Draft migration guide created at /docs/migrate/sdk-0.10-to-0.12.md — includes before/after snippets, a short checklist for ops, and a note about redirect changes.
Tony: PR ready for review: snippets + small inline docs changes. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4582 (will include README note and changelog bullet).
Kevin: I pushed the redirect patch to infra repo — will coordinate with ops for rollout window.
Sarah: Next steps: Tony opens final snippets PR (done), Joni posts full linkcheck report and patches (in PR comments), Kevin ensures redirect + deprecation blurb, I’ll assemble the relnotes draft and ping @product for a quick QA. Aim to have relnotes + changelog draft up for review by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: Checklist created and assigned: [snippets PR, linkcheck report, redirect patch, relnotes draft]. Due: 24h.
